rules.name: correlation/brute_force_event_count.yml
rules.content:
title: Failed Logon For Brute Force Correlation
id: 2c657f75-9250-43cd-ba71-727e08d05e6f
name: sf_failed_logon
status: test
description: Base rule for the correlation below. It is only converted alone where the target supports correlations.
author: Sigma Forge samples
date: 2026-11-11
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: security
detection:
  selection:
    EventID: 4625
  condition: selection
level: low
---
title: Brute Force From One Source Address
id: b06c5bce-c402-491c-83f7-4778bde7ae0c
status: test
description: Ten or more failed logons from the same source address in five minutes.
author: Sigma Forge samples
date: 2026-11-11
correlation:
  type: event_count
  rules:
    - sf_failed_logon
  group-by:
    - IpAddress
  timespan: 5m
  condition:
    gte: 10
tags:
  - attack.credential-access
  - attack.t1110.001
level: high

title: Password Spray Many Users From One Source
id: 1ffa3334-06a8-420a-a134-64b823defe5f
status: test
description: Twenty or more different user names failing from one source in ten minutes. Uses value_count, which Wazuh cannot do.
author: Sigma Forge samples
date: 2026-11-11
correlation:
  type: value_count
  rules:
    - sf_failed_logon_spray
  group-by:
    - IpAddress
  timespan: 10m
  condition:
    field: TargetUserName
    gte: 20
tags:
  - attack.credential-access
  - attack.t1110.003
level: high
